scope: Independent read-only cross-review of all 16 local-coding numbered items, changed prose, actual Lean endpoint hypotheses, and proof-outline dependencies.

items.label: def:local-public-strategy
items.actual_lean_comparison: LocalQuery support locality and PublicStrategy.Executes require every query answer and terminal halt, with no transmitted halt bit. Finite ambient helper, complete runs on all of F, and own-original-row decoding match the separator endpoints.
items.program_relevance: Defines the original-row interface to which the separator impossibility test applies.

items.label: thm:local-adaptive-separator
items.actual_lean_comparison: All quantifiers, coefficients, loss terms and probability-law hypotheses match graph_expected_separator_bound_of_distribution. Correctness on zero-mass elements is retained. The outline separates virtual product fibers from correlated correct fibers, then applies two conditional budgets.
items.program_relevance: Excludes a fixed fractional saving when expected separator loss, input deficit and helper entropy are negligible.

items.label: cor:local-separator-worst
items.actual_lean_comparison: Natural B,L,g and nonempty F match the worst-case endpoint. The entropy estimate charges the attained image while retaining a finite ambient helper type.
items.program_relevance: Direct rejection test from worst-case candidate parameters.

items.label: thm:local-separator-sharpness
items.actual_lean_comparison: The two separate d=2, b>0 witnesses match the coefficient endpoints. Other charges vanish in the appropriate witness; no joint optimality claim is made.
items.program_relevance: Rules out improving either factor 2 alone and guides strengthening toward extra structure or other terms.

items.label: lem:local-treewidth-fragmentation
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches arbitrary finite SimpleGraph, natural L, ordinary finite decomposition, and exact integer budget. The component loss estimate follows the displayed fragment size bound.
items.program_relevance: Provides the separator choice needed to optimize the expected treewidth obstruction; treated as a standard dependency.

items.label: cor:local-treewidth
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches the distributional theorem including d,b>0, real epsilon, positive part, coefficient 1/4 and linear rounding term. The integer optimization and its identity agree with the source derivation.
items.program_relevance: Requires linear expected treewidth for any constant expected saving with negligible information charges.

items.label: def:local-recoded-xor
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches rowwise equivalences, fixed packet system, own-original-row side information, full-cube correctness, and same-row-or-adjacent locality. Self-XOR and repeated packets are valid in the actual XorPacket definition.
items.program_relevance: Defines a restricted candidate format tested independently of small-separator arguments.

items.label: thm:local-xor-distance
items.actual_lean_comparison: Both displayed forms match the exact scaled and real endpoint. Ell=0 and disconnected pairs remain allowed. The orbit outline uses transformed flips and basepoint-uniform preservation, not a linearization of raw rows.
items.program_relevance: Bounds savings by graph-neighborhood growth even after nonlinear bijective row preprocessing.

items.label: cor:local-xor-degree
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches d>=2, arbitrary natural degree cap, log(max(2,Delta)) and factor 6. The half-log integer budget matches the Lean proof. The asymptotic interpretation now explicitly assumes b>0.
items.program_relevance: Excludes fixed fractional savings on every bounded-degree row graph in this packet format, including expanders.

items.label: cor:local-xor-cycle
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches injective homomorphism into cycleGraph with nonzero size, d>0, and the general linear near-ball cap. Shifted square-root error and rounding argument match the proved endpoint.
items.program_relevance: Sharpens the available exclusion error to O(P/sqrt(d)) for the listed path/cycle geometry.

items.label: def:local-triangular-causal
items.actual_lean_comparison: The order permutations are rankings; triangular dependence uses earlier incoming rows with an own-row equivalence, while causal dependence uses the full incoming prefix and may be noninjective. These match both structure definitions and apply functions.
items.program_relevance: Defines permitted nonlinear coupling before the two-stage counting test.

items.label: def:local-two-stage
items.actual_lean_comparison: All three permutation directions and local-map placements agree with TwoStageRows.input, forward, finalMap and apply. The helper may have an infinite ambient type and selects the entire branch.
items.program_relevance: Specifies the exact one-bank architecture whose unrestricted primitive maps still incur a helper toll.

items.label: lem:local-block-injective
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches BlockInjective, triangular induction, finite bijection, rowwise postcomposition and inverse-complement closure. The property is derived for the branch, not assumed.
items.program_relevance: Supplies the recovery step needed for the injective record in the branch count.

items.label: lem:local-branch-count
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches all finite correct F, including empty/correlated sets, and every r<=d. The sets I,R,J and record direction agree with TwoStageRows and FixedSupportSandwich; raw columns outside J plus recorded rectangle recover the required rows.
items.program_relevance: Limits the number of inputs handled by one helper branch.

items.label: thm:local-helper-count
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches all split counts, exact floor(d^2/4), natural helper range exponent, and real density deficit. The empty-set scope and positivity needed for logarithms are stated correctly.
items.program_relevance: Converts per-branch capacity into a required helper range or correct-family deficit.

items.label: thm:local-helper-entropy
items.actual_lean_comparison: Matches arbitrary normalized nonnegative laws, infinite ambient helper, attained finite subtype and both exact tolls. The outline uses the actual fiber entropy lemma valid for unnormalized nonnegative weights before specializing to a probability law.
items.program_relevance: Charges actual helper entropy, so uneven helper distributions do not evade the two-stage obstruction.

resolved_findings.issue: Random separator loss in the asymptotic consequence should explicitly be expected loss.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owner changed to expected separator loss.

resolved_findings.issue: Section allows b=0, so bounded-degree fractional-saving interpretation should specify positive entry width.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owner added b>0 to the asymptotic sentence while preserving finite b=0 inequality.

limitations: Source-level semantic review; the root performs the final Lean build and axiom checks.
Restricted coding model results do not normalize arbitrary tape computations into those models.

checks.check: All 16 numbered English items are no stronger than the actual Lean statements and defining interfaces.
All proof outlines follow the reviewed Lean proof routes, including nonlinear recoding, correlated fibers, exact branch supports and quantifier order.
All 12 proved results and 4 definitions have explicit program relevance in nearby text.
Finite and asymptotic domains, helper alphabets, input support, zero masses and zero dimensions/widths are distinguished.
Requested expected-loss and positive-width wording fixes are present in the final reviewed source.
No stronger general tape, arbitrary-linear-broadcast or multistage conclusion is asserted.
